paragraphs: In the morning, clear emails and correspondence and enter a batch of forms. At midday, coordinate with finance to retrieve receipts. In the afternoon, file documents, reconcile accounts, and direct visitors. Before leaving, prepare tomorrow's task list and ensure registers have no gaps.

Employment is projected to fall to 2,468,200 by 2034, a net loss of about 177,800 jobs, with roughly 282,400 openings per year and a median annual wage of about $43,600 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).

AI will not replace office clerks, but it will reduce standard roles. Automated entry and electronic filing accelerate routine paperwork, shifting clerks from entering forms toward coordination, exception handling, and interpersonal communication. Roles limited to data entry will lose ground, while people who coordinate become more valuable.

Start by mastering office software. Pure order-entry work is shrinking in the AI era, so build coordination skills early.
